description: 🚀 Hey everyone! We are SPACE CADETS , a team of enthusiastic beginners super excited to participate in the NASA Space Apps Challenge!
summary:
Smallholder farmers in Taroudant face mounting vulnerabilities due to unpredictable climate shifts and water scarcity. To bridge the gap between complex orbital data and daily farming decisions, we developed an intelligent, accessible agricultural decision-support prototype.

Our solution directly addresses the NASA Space Apps Challenge by translating multi-source Earth observation data including NASA POWER, SMAP, ECOSTRESS, and Landsat/MODIS (NDVI) into intuitive, localized indicators for crop selection, optimal planting windows, and real-time field tracking. Unlike generic global monitoring tools, our platform is specifically designed to empower small-scale farmers with hyper-local, actionable insights that optimize water usage and secure crop yields.
details:
FELLAH SPACE is a smart agriculture platform designed to help farmers monitor their farms and make informed agricultural decisions. Initially focused on Taroudant and the Souss-Massa region of Morocco, it combines farm location data, NASA Earth observation data, weather information, and digital agricultural tools.

Farmers can enter their location or use GPS to access local environmental information, including temperature, rainfall, humidity, and wind speed.

The project aims to improve water management, support climate-resilient agriculture, help farmers identify environmental risks, and make satellite information easier to understand. Our ultimate goal is to support more sustainable farming, especially in regions affected by drought and water scarcity.

We used :

  • HTML5 – website structure.
  • CSS3 – responsive design and visual interface.
  • JavaScript – interactive features and data processing.
  • NASA POWER API – daily agricultural weather and environmental data.
  • OpenStreetMap and Nominatim – map and geographical location services.
  • Browser Geolocation API – GPS-based farm positioning.
  • Browser Speech Synthesis and Speech Recognition – voice assistance.
  • Lucide Icons – interface icons.
  • JSON and Fetch API – retrieving and processing external data.
  • FELLEH SPACE brings satellite-based environmental information, geographical positioning, weather monitoring, and farmer-friendly digital tools together in one platform. It also introduces features such as plant-health screening, multilingual support, and voice assistance to make agricultural technology more accessible.

We considered the agricultural challenges of Souss-Massa, particularly drought, water scarcity, climate variability, accessibility, ease of use, and the different needs of small farmers and large agricultural businesses.
